titleAr: اقرا سبب إيقاف متجري واعترض عليه
titleEn: Read why my store is suspended and appeal
screens: banner on every store page while suspended

en: How do I appeal a suspension?

steps: Open any store page, read the banner, press Appeal this decision, explain, send
edgeCases: Only one open appeal per store (second is 409)
A store that is not suspended answers 404
A billing suspension shows its billing reason and is not appealed; settle the invoice
Ebda staff decide the appeal; reactivating the store resolves it
